note.zh: 云由小水滴或冰晶组成：厚云有暗部，高处可有薄纱状冰云。此处高度差放大、天气运动加速，并非实时云图。
note.en: Clouds contain droplets or ice crystals: thick clouds have shaded structure; high ice clouds can be wispy. Height differences and motion are exaggerated, not live weather.

note.zh: 水星只有极稀薄的外逸层，没有地球式云海。表面贴图保留陨石坑，近景起伏是区域重建。
note.en: Mercury has a very thin exosphere, not Earth-like cloud decks. Surface maps retain craters; close-up relief is a regional reconstruction.

note.zh: 太空中看到的是硫酸云层，无法直接透过它看清地面。下降后的岩石景观参考探测资料重建，云层流动经过加速。
note.en: From space we see sulfuric-acid clouds, which obscure the ground. Rocks encountered during descent are reconstructed from mission evidence; cloud motion is accelerated.

note.zh: 红色来自表面含铁尘土；南极既有水冰，也有随季节变化的二氧化碳冰。这里固定在所选地点，展示代表性季节。
note.en: Iron-bearing dust colors the surface. The south pole has water ice and seasonally changing carbon-dioxide ice. The selected site shows a representative season.

note.zh: 条带和涡旋属于大气，没有可站立的云面。极区气旋结构参考朱诺探测；不同仪器看到的细节被合并展示，色彩与速度经过调整。
note.en: Bands and vortices belong to the atmosphere, without ground to stand on. Polar cyclones follow Juno observations; detail from different instruments is combined, with adjusted colors and speeds.

note.zh: 土星云带较柔和，北极六边形是一股弯曲的喷流。内部的混合核心可能逐渐过渡，剖面分区不是硬壳。
note.en: Saturn has muted cloud bands; its north-polar hexagon is a meandering jet. A diffuse interior core may blend gradually into surrounding material; cutaway regions are not hard shells.

note.zh: 可见光下偏淡青绿，云层对比很低；红外照片会显出更多结构。内部成分尚未定论，“冰巨星”不表示脚下有固态冰地面。 图中只选取部分暗窄环，并放大了宽度。
note.en: Visible light shows a pale cyan-green world with low cloud contrast; infrared reveals more structure. Interior composition is unresolved: “ice giant” does not mean solid ice ground. Only selected dark narrow rings are shown, with enlarged widths.

note.zh: 颜色参考重新校准的观测，接近青蓝而非浓艳深蓝。暗涡与亮云是可变化的天气；这里不是某一天的实况，内部也没有确定的海底。
note.en: Color follows recalibrated observations: cyan-blue, not intensely deep blue. Dark vortices and bright clouds are changing weather, not today’s view. No definite ocean floor is known inside.

note.zh: 太阳光球的颗粒来自对流，黑子较冷。暖色与日珥对比经过增强；这不是肉眼观察太阳时的颜色或可安全接近的地面。
note.en: Photospheric granules trace convection; sunspots are cooler. Warm colors and prominence contrast are enhanced, not the Sun’s naked-eye color or a safe surface.

note.zh: 月球没有地球式云层。表面的明暗地区与陨石坑来自已有贴图，局部细节为区域重建；内部依据地震与重力等资料推断。
note.en: The Moon has no Earth-like clouds. Maps supply broad albedo and craters; local detail is reconstructed. Its interior is inferred from seismic and gravity evidence.

note.zh: 橙色雾霾遮住表面，湖泊主要含甲烷和乙烷，不是蓝色水海。地下含水物质的分布与物态仍有模型争议。
note.en: Orange haze obscures the surface. Lakes mainly contain methane and ethane, not blue seas of water. Subsurface water distribution and state remain model-dependent.
